name: Aoto Masanori
source:
Masanori is the homeroom teacher of [url=/c1185]Kouhei[/url], [url=/c1188]Haruna[/url], [url=/c1190]Kiriha[/url] and [url=/c1200]Tsukasa's[/url] class, as well as the one in-charge of the male side of the school dormitory. He teaches Chemistry. Has a mild personality. Takes towards an independence and autonomy approach in education. He is usually known by the nickname "Aonori", while [url=/c1187]Kanade[/url] calls him "Noripii". Was known to be a troublemaker during his younger days.

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fortune_Arterial]Wikipedia[/url].]
